summary: Full frontend prototype tested at mobile viewport 390x844. Splash -> Onboarding (3 slides) -> Auth (phone/email tabs, OTP flow) -> Home works cleanly. All 5 bottom tabs render with correct tab testIDs (tab-home, tab-find, tab-visits, tab-sessions, tab-account). Home shows active TRN-014 card, notifications bell, avatar, quick actions, nearby-b1..b3 branch cards and upcoming reservation. Find tab has search input, all 5 filter chips and branch cards. Branch detail shows hero, chips, Directions/Call, service list and Join-a-line CTA. Ticket screen (/ticket/t1) shows ticket-number-display 'TRN-014', verification code, advance & cancel buttons and progresses via ticket-advance-btn (routed to /called/t1 after enough taps). Called screen countdown decrements every second (5:00 -> 4:58 verified). Session detail sticky Reserve button navigates to reservation with access code 'W7TH-JCM4'. Visits tabs, Account rows (notifications/saved-branches/accessibility/language/help/signout), Notifications and Help screens all render. No red-screen errors, no console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx useEffect has empty deps but reads onboardingComplete - fine for prototype since replace happens once, but flagged for correctness.
Home 'active ticket card' is conditional on store.activeTicketId - store must be seeded so first-time users see the TRN-014 card the PRD expects (verified working today via store default).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All required testIDs exist and pass. Note: Join wizard route is /join/[serviceId]?branchId=... (opened from branch-join-line-btn). When on stack screens like /join/*, /ticket/*, /session/*, /reservation/*, /called/*, the bottom tab bar is intentionally hidden (Expo Router stack). Use direct page.goto for those screens. Splash auto-navigates after ~1.6s, so waits >=2.2s before interacting with welcome.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no issues found in this test run.
